title: 第25章 被赵婶调戏第26章 再坚持一下
slug: 乡村大炮第296章先宣传一波
content_zh:
李大炮没有立即回村，他来到了车行，现在有钱了，自然得鸟枪换炮，先买一辆摩托三轮车，这样方便以后运货。
他现在还是一副比较困难的着装，破旧变形的t恤衫，褪色的沙滩裤，还有一双沾满泥土的人字拖。
大家都已经开始穿外套了，他还穿着一件t恤衫，不免让人有些同情。
“小伙子，你是哪个村的人？”
车行老板问道，他都有种想法，看看有没有不穿的破旧外套，送给李大炮几件。
不是李大炮不穿外套，而是他根本感觉不到冷，而且还感觉身子有些发热。
“我是牛犊子村的。”李大炮回道。
“牛犊子村。”
车行老板表示明白了，因为那是一个最穷最偏僻的小村子，有这么困难的人也说得过去。
“老板，这三轮车多少钱？”李大炮问道。
“这三轮车进价就要五千多，你要是买得起的话，六千就给你。”
车行老板笑道，平常最少卖别人七八千，他觉得就李大炮这个样子，肯定买不起。
“叮，支付宝到账六千块。”
李大炮直接扫码付钱，他见这老板还算诚实，就不跟他讨价还价了。
但是老板有些懵了，这真是牛犊子村的贫困户吗，做生意这么爽快？
“哎呦。”
车行老板一拍脑袋，他都没想到李大炮买得起，这下少赚了一两千块钱。
“老板，你不会出尔反尔吧？”
“那，那倒不至于，不过你可不要跟别人说是这个价格买的，最少跟别人说八千八。”
“我懂。”

李大炮表示明白，看样子还真占了一个便宜。
片刻之后，他开上了摩托三轮车，加满了油，立即返回牛犊子村。
不得不说，鸟枪换炮的感觉就是不错。
牛犊子村。
李长贵买回来了不少验孕纸，他说道：“秋玲，以后每天早上都测一次，只要怀上了，那就立即停止。”
叶秋玲有些不乐意，好日子才刚刚开始，她自然不想这么快就打回冷宫。
“看样子得做一些措施了，避免这么早怀上。”
叶秋玲心中暗道，随后试探性的问了一句：“长贵，你说，要是我生了个女儿，你打算怎么办？”
“生女儿也行，听说有的地方彩礼很高，把女儿嫁过去，也能大赚一笔。”
李长贵美滋滋的说道，这家伙还想卖女儿赚钱。
叶秋玲也是服了，别人彩礼高，那都是给小两口准备的家庭启动资金。
或许有那么极个别父母非常自私，没有还给小两口，但绝大多数基本都是还给小两口子的。
“那你不要儿子了？”叶秋玲继续问道。
“要，怎么不要，生完女儿再继续生呗，只要你没绝经，那就一直生。”
李长贵说道，他似乎还找到了一条生财之道，准备把叶秋玲当成生产机器。
叶秋玲自然不会配合，如果真这样虐待她的话，那她就只能跑了。
李大炮还没有回到牛犊子村，因为在路上碰到了赶集回来的赵婶。
赵婶和张婶差不多，姿色一般般，膀大腰粗，典型的村妇，只有李大柱这样的人看得上。
但是村里的村妇又看不上李大柱，她们只对李大炮感兴趣。
content_en:
Li Dapao did not return to the village immediately. He came to the car dealer. Now that he had money, he naturally had to replace his guns with guns and buy a motorcycle tricycle first, which would make it easier to transport goods in the future.
He still wears a rather difficult attire, consisting of a torn and deformed T-shirt, faded beach shorts, and a pair of mud-stained flip-flops.
Everyone was already wearing coats, and he was still wearing a T-shirt, which made people feel a little sympathetic.
"Young man, which village are you from?"
The owner of the car dealership asked. He had an idea to see if there were any worn-out coats that he didn't wear and give some to Li Dapao.
It wasn't that Li Dapao didn't wear a coat, but that he couldn't feel the cold at all, and he also felt a little warm.
"I'm from Niuduzi Village." Li Dapao replied.
"Niuduzi Village."
The owner of the car dealer said that he understood, because it was the poorest and most remote small village, and it was understandable for people with such difficulties.
"Boss, how much does this tricycle cost?" Li Dapao asked.
"The purchase price of this tricycle is more than five thousand. If you can afford it, I will give you six thousand."
The owner of the car dealership smiled and said that he usually sold it to others for at least seven or eight thousand, but he felt that someone like Li Dapao would definitely not be able to afford it.
"Ding, Alipay has received 6,000 yuan."
Li Dapao scanned the QR code and paid directly. Seeing that the boss was quite honest, he stopped bargaining with him.
But the boss was a little confused. Is this really a poor household in Niuduzi Village? Doing business is so refreshing?
"Ouch."
The owner of the car dealership slapped his head. He didn't expect that Li Dapao could afford it, so he made one or two thousand yuan less.
"Boss, you won't go back on your word, right?"
"Well, that's not the case, but don't tell others that you bought it at this price. At least tell others 8,800."
"I understand."
Li Dapao said he understood, and it seemed that he really had an advantage.
After a while, he drove the motorcycle tricycle, filled up the tank with gas, and immediately returned to Niuduzi Village.
I have to say that it feels good to replace a shotgun with a cannon.
Niuduzi Village.
Li Changgui bought a lot of pregnancy test papers. He said, "Qiu Ling, you will take a test every morning from now on. As soon as you become pregnant, stop immediately."
Ye Qiuling was a little unhappy. The good times had just begun, and she naturally didn't want to be thrown back into the cold palace so soon.
"It seems like we need to take some measures to avoid getting pregnant so early."
Ye Qiuling thought to herself, and then asked tentatively: "Changgui, tell me, what are you going to do if I give birth to a daughter?"
"It's okay to have a daughter. I heard that in some places, the bride price is very high. If you marry your daughter, you can make a lot of money."
Li Changgui said happily, this guy still wants to sell his daughter to make money.
Ye Qiuling was also convinced. Others had high betrothal gifts, which were all family start-up funds prepared for the young couple.
There may be a very few parents who are very selfish and do not return the money to the young couple, but the vast majority basically give it back to the young couple.
"Then you don't want a son?" Ye Qiuling continued to ask.
"Yes, why don't you? Just keep having babies after you give birth to your daughter. As long as you're not menopausal, you can keep having babies."
Li Changgui said that he seemed to have found a way to make money and planned to use Ye Qiuling as a production machine.
Ye Qiuling would naturally not cooperate. If he really abused her like this, she would have no choice but to run away.
Li Dapao hasn't returned to Niuduzi Village yet because he met Aunt Zhao on the road who was returning from the market.
Aunt Zhao is similar to Aunt Zhang, with average looks, big arms and thick waist, a typical village woman, only people like Li Dazhu can like her.
But the village women in the village looked down upon Li Dazhu. They were only interested in Li Dapao.
